parts.t: What types of homes are for sale in North Meadows, Pitt Meadows?

Active MLS® listings in North Meadows typically include Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) blueberry and cranberry farms, equestrian acreages, and rural country estates north of Lougheed Highway toward Pitt Lake and the Alouette River. In Q3 2026, North Meadows recorded Detached & acreage median $1,950,000 ($640/sq ft, 87,120 sq ft / 2.00-acre median lot). Every listing at the top of this page updates automatically from the Greater Vancouver Realtors (GVR) MLS® feed.
Which School District 42 schools serve North Meadows in Pitt Meadows?

Public schools serving or located near North Meadows include Davie Jones Elementary (12030 Blakely Rd, K-7), Pitt Meadows Elementary (11941 Harris Rd, French Immersion), and Pitt Meadows Secondary (19438 116B Ave, 8-12). Always verify exact street-address catchment boundaries using the official School District 42 (Maple Ridge – Pitt Meadows) locator before removing subjects.
What parks, trails, and recreation facilities are near North Meadows?

Residents of North Meadows enjoy access to Pitt-Addington Marsh Wildlife Management Area, Grant Narrows Regional Park on Pitt Lake, Pitt River Regional Greenway dike trails, and Swan-E-Set Bay Resort & Country Club (16651 Rannie Rd). See our companion
North Meadows Neighbourhood Guide
for full park addresses, trail networks, and community recreation details.
How are roads, West Coast Express access, and commuting in North Meadows?

Primary commuter and road corridors serving North Meadows include Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), Harris Road, Neaves Road, Kennedy Road, McNeil Road, and Rannie Road, connecting residents to Lougheed Highway (Hwy 7), Dewdney Trunk Road, the Golden Ears Bridge, and TransLink RapidBus (R3) and West Coast Express commuter rail stations.
What zoning, Official Community Plan, or ALR rules apply in North Meadows?

North Meadows is almost entirely within the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) and the Alouette/Pitt River floodplain under City of Pitt Meadows Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011 (A-1 General Agricultural and A-2 Large Lot Agricultural zones) and the North Lougheed Area Plan (Bylaw No. 3060, 2026, adopted September 29, 2026). You can inspect parcel-level setbacks, lot sizes, and suite permissions in our
Pitt Meadows Zoning Guide
What are the 2021 Statistics Canada Census demographics for North Meadows?

According to the 2021 Statistics Canada Census (custom GVR sub-area boundary compilation), North Meadows has a population of 2,320 across 835 occupied private dwellings, a median household income of $128,000, and an owner-occupancy rate of 86%.
